description:
## Empirical signal (2026-05-04)

User-tier POLYBIUS gave PRINCIPAL the wrong activation paste for the-stoa team (project-tier install). Pasted: 'Read .claude/MAJOR_POLYBIUS_the_stoa.md and assume the role.' — but project mode deploys MAJORs UNSUFFIXED. The actual file is .claude/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md.

Result: Claude Code session in the-stoa/ couldn't find the suffixed file, fell back to global ~/.claude/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md, activated as user-tier POLYBIUS in the-stoa directory (wrong tier), ran bw prime against user-beadwork (wrong bw store). PRINCIPAL caught it: 'I can't step back so long as things are not working.'

## Root cause: silent filename divergence between modes

install.sh deploys MAJORs differently depending on --target:

| Mode | MAJOR filename | CLAUDE.md auto-load? | Activation paste |
|---|---|---|---|
| --target user | MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md (unsuffixed) at ~/.claude/ | yes (global CLAUDE.md ref) | 'POLYBIUS' (auto-load) |
| --target project --modify-claude-md | MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md (unsuffixed) at .claude/ | yes (project CLAUDE.md ref) | 'POLYBIUS' (auto-load) |
| --target project (no --modify-claude-md) | MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md (unsuffixed) at .claude/ | no | 'Read .claude/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md and assume the role.' |
| --target subproject | MAJOR_POLYBIUS_<slug>.md (suffixed) at <parent>/<sub>/.claude/ | no (never modifies parent CLAUDE.md) | 'Read .claude/MAJOR_POLYBIUS_<slug>.md and assume the role.' |

The CAPTAINs are ALWAYS suffixed when there's a slug (project + subproject). MAJORs are only suffixed in subproject mode. This asymmetry is documented in install.sh comments but not surfaced in any operational doc that POLYBIUS instances or PRINCIPAL would naturally read.

## What needs to change

1. **install.sh next-step output** already prints the right activation paste at end of install run, but we humans miss it. Make it more prominent. Print the activation paste in a clearly demarcated block ('=== ACTIVATION (copy this) ===') so it's harder to miss + so future POLYBIUS reading the install log can quote it accurately.

2. **Substrate doc** (probably MAJOR_POLYBIUS §5 or a new substrate/templates/activation-paste-cheatsheet.md) explicitly documents the four mode-paste pairs. POLYBIUS instances coordinating installs (and PRINCIPAL when verifying) have a single canonical reference.

3. **Optional: install.sh writes the correct activation paste to HUMAN_paste-orchestrator-instruction.md at install time.** Currently this file is written by POLYBIUS at first activation per §4.5 + §5.1; it could be SEEDED by install.sh with the activation line itself, then enriched by POLYBIUS later. Trade-off: install.sh becomes more interactive; or harmless seed gets overwritten.

4. **POLYBIUS's section §5.1 (paste-instruction templating)** — currently describes template slots for the orchestrator paste-instruction; should also describe slots for the POLYBIUS activation paste itself, including which mode produces which filename.

## Why this matters

Activation is the load-bearing step that turns 'paste content' into 'role correctly assumed.' A wrong paste fails silently in a frustrating way: the session activates as the WRONG seat (falls back to global), bw prime hits the wrong store, and the agent thinks they're project-tier when they're operating user-tier. PRINCIPAL has no visibility into this divergence until they notice the wrong tickets in the agent's report.

The fix is small (clearer install.sh output + a substrate cheatsheet) but the failure mode is high-friction.

## Reference

- install.sh next-steps section (lines 850-893)
- MAJOR_POLYBIUS §5 (onboarding) + §5.1 (paste templating)
- ariadne-core-workspace install yesterday (project + --modify-claude-md, worked because auto-load)
- ariadne-core sub-project install yesterday (subproject, suffixed, worked because correct paste given)
- the-stoa install today (project, no --modify-claude-md, FAILED because user-tier POLYBIUS gave suffixed paste instead of unsuffixed)
title: Activation paste-instruction inconsistency: project mode vs sub-project mode MAJORs use different filenames, activation pastes diverge silently
